narr: After morning thunderstorms shifted southeast of the area, a second large complex of thunderstorms redeveloped over Mississippi during the late morning and early afternoon hours. This complex shifted east into Alabama during the mid to late afternoon hours, exiting northeast Alabama during the early evening hours. Several reports of thunderstorm wind damage were received, along with one large hail report. In addition, rainfall of 1-2 inches fell in a very short period of time, causing flash flooding that washed out a bridge in Cullman County and flooded several streets in Marshall County.
ev: Flash flooding reported at Mose Chapel at Browns Ferry Road.
County Road 1447 bridge washed out due to pipes in the dirt road being exposed. Additional road closures reported on CR 1427 due to the bridge being washed out.
